en.testNote: Every figure comes from using the device **together with d'Alba White Truffle Double Serum & Cream**. 22 people / individual variation. There are no device-only figures.

howto.name: Before you start
howto.how: Cleanse, then apply plenty of skincare. The device needs product on the skin to work.

howto.name: Intensive care
howto.how: Press the head flat to the skin and work through cheeks, forehead, contour, nasolabial folds, jaw and neck — 40 shots, then it shuts off.

howto.name: Levels
howto.how: Starts at level 1, goes up to 5. Drop a level around the eyes, mouth and sides of the nose.

howto.name: How often
howto.how: One to three times a day, every day. 40 shots per session.

say.line: You have to put skincare on first. If your face dries out, the energy doesn't get through and it stings.
say.why: Both a usage instruction and a safety point. Say it early.

say.line: There's no cartridge, so the shots never run out and there's nothing more to buy.
say.why: The main objection to home devices is running costs. This answers it.

say.line: It counts 40 shots and switches itself off.
say.why: Removes the 'how long do I use it?' question entirely.

careful: **Every figure comes from using the device with the Double Serum & Cream.** 'With the cream on, using this device' is the accurate framing. There are no device-only numbers.
**This is a beauty device, not a medical device.** That line appears on every page of the deck. Don't liken it to a procedure or a treatment.
**It must be used with skincare on the skin.** A dry face means no energy transfer and a stinging sensation.
Raising the level doesn't send energy deeper. Drop a level around the eyes, mouth and sides of the nose.
